summary: Return values in a predictable order.
documentation: sorted is a built-in function that returns a new list in sorted order. key can extract a comparison value, and reverse changes the direction. Sorting is stable for equal keys.
inputs: An iterable; optional key function and reverse boolean.
caution: sorted creates a list; list.sort changes an existing list in place and returns None.
scenarios: Rank appointment durations for capacity planning.
Build consistent lists for customer-facing screens.
title: Sort the appointment durations
problem: Given an array of integer appointment durations, return a new list in ascending numeric order. Preserve duplicate durations.
goal: Use sorted() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
